limits: Reporter game version, save, hardware, equipment, injuries and reload behavior are unknown. The user is forwarding another player's report.
Prepared party and route, original-look graphics, opened gate and neutralized hostility are controlled inputs. All 62 authored actors, original scripts and obstacles remain loaded.
This is a remake regression check, not an original executable comparison or a reproduction of the reporter's saved state.
Windows results use Wine on Linux, not native Windows.
A passing control does not establish that the external report is fixed or invalid.

Linux OpenGL completes all movement assertions and exits 0, but emits two 349,524-byte GL texture-leak diagnostics during shutdown. Explicit test cache cleanup did not remove them. It is not a clean renderer result, and no causal connection to the reported slowdown is established.
status: Severe reported slowdown not reproduced; no production fix claimed.
